flags.no_catalog: No flags catalog found. You can still type flags manually.
flags.desc.cpu: Run everything on the CPU (slow, but works without a GPU).
flags.desc.directml: Use torch-directml (AMD / DirectX 12 GPUs on Windows).
flags.desc.cuda_device: Select CUDA device id(s), e.g. 0 or 0,1.
flags.desc.gpu_only: Keep everything on the GPU (fastest, needs lots of VRAM).
flags.desc.highvram: Keep models in VRAM between runs.
flags.desc.lowvram: Run text encoders on the CPU to save VRAM.
flags.desc.novram: Most aggressive VRAM saving, for very low-VRAM GPUs.
flags.desc.reserve_vram: Reserve N GB of VRAM for the OS / other apps.
flags.desc.disable_smart_memory: Aggressively offload models to system RAM.
flags.desc.fp16_vae: Run the VAE in fp16 (faster, may cause black images).
flags.desc.fp32_vae: Run the VAE in full-precision fp32 (most compatible).
flags.desc.fp16_unet: Run the diffusion model in fp16.
flags.desc.bf16_unet: Run the diffusion model in bf16.
flags.desc.fp8_e4m3fn_unet: Store diffusion-model weights in fp8 (saves memory).
flags.desc.cache_none: Minimal RAM/VRAM use; re-runs every node each time.
flags.desc.cache_lru: Cache up to N node results (uses more RAM/VRAM).
flags.desc.listen: Listen on a given IP (bare = all interfaces).
flags.desc.preview_method: Latent preview method for sampler nodes.
flags.desc.disable_api_nodes: Disable API nodes and their internet access.

about.text:
ComfyLauncher makes launching and configuring portable ComfyUI simple and intuitive.
It brings together everything you need - from build selection and startup flags to color themes.
The core idea is comfort, clarity, and an easy start.

ComfyLauncher is developed by Alexandra "nondeletable", a programmer who creates complete, ready-to-use applications, together with Maxim "max-modum", who takes an active part in developing the app and refining its interface.
We focus not only on functionality but also on visual harmony, usability and a cohesive interface, so that every tool works out of the box.

I'm open to collaborations and new opportunities. If you have an idea or need a Python developer to bring it to life, feel free to reach out.
If you enjoy ComfyLauncher, you can support the project with a tip - it is greatly appreciated and keeps the work going.
about.footer: Developed by nondeletable & max-modum · v{version} · PyQt6 · 2026
